MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

3. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 30

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
